attr.title: SUPER Maze Robo
attr.desc: A small Mega Man like platformer made for SNES graphics game jam 2. Follow Maze Robo on a quest to save his GREATEST TREASURE after a group called the Shooting Robbers stole it. Travel through giant trees and flying ships to get to their castle to take it back, NO MATTER HOW MANY TIMES IT TAKES.
attr.inst:
Controls are: 

D-pad/ L-anolog: to move

B: Jump

Y:shoot

A: skip text

F/guide: to reset save
